2f3022534473e2e9.description: About the Role BRC Industrial Saudia is seeking an experienced Site Civil Engineer to join our team in Makkah, with projects spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in the installation, construction, and supervision of security fence systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing site activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations, and delivering projects on schedule and within budget. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage all site activities related to security fence installation projects. Review project drawings, specifications, and technical documents. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors. Conduct site surveys, setting out, and measurement verification. Monitor construction progress and ensure adherence to project schedules. Ensure compliance with quality standards and project requirements. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports. Coordinate procurement and delivery of materials required for fence installation. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with applicable safety regulations and company policies. Identify technical issues on site and propose effective solutions. Conduct inspections and testing activities related to foundation works, posts, gates, and associated civil works. Verify quantities and prepare site records for billing and project documentation. Attend project meetings and provide technical support when required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as a Civil Site Engineer. Demonstrated experience in the installation, construction, and supervision of security fence systems. Experience with high-security facilities, airports, industrial plants, oil & gas facilities, or critical infrastructure projects is preferred. Knowledge of perimeter intrusion detection systems (PIDS), access control systems, and security integrations is an advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with project sites primarily in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves managing on-site activities and coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure project success.

2fbe682a3a4019be.description: About the Role Nesma & Partners Contracting Co. Ltd. is seeking a Lead Structural Design Engineer to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves leading structural design projects within the construction and building industry. The role requires leveraging expertise to manage complex engineering tasks and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality results. Role Overview As a Lead Structural Design Engineer, you will be responsible for designing robust structures and mentoring junior engineers. The position involves fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning within the team, ensuring projects adhere to high standards of safety and sustainability. This role offers an opportunity to influence strategic decisions and contribute to the organization's vision by guiding the development of innovative engineering solutions for the construction sector. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and analysis of structural systems for various building projects, ensuring compliance with local codes and regulations using advanced engineering software. Collaborate with architects and other engineering disciplines to integrate structural design with architectural vision, ensuring seamless project execution. Conduct detailed structural assessments and evaluations, providing recommendations to enhance safety and performance of existing structures. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering professional development within the engineering team. Prepare comprehensive reports and documentation, communicating design concepts, calculations, and project progress to stakeholders and clients. Manage project timelines and budgets, ensuring deliverables are met on schedule and within financial constraints while maintaining quality standards. Lead site inspections and coordinate with construction teams to address structural issues during the building process, ensuring compliance with design specifications. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in structural engineering technology, implementing innovative practices to enhance project efficiency. Participate in strategic planning meetings, contributing insights that shape the company's engineering vision and project direction. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in structural design. Expertise in concrete structure design is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role involves working within a collaborative environment where contributions impact project outcomes in the construction sector. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2fc5aa23f0265cc8.description: About the Role Boehringer Ingelheim is seeking a Medical Representative to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves effectively representing and promoting Boehringer Ingelheim's core products to healthcare professionals, ensuring appropriate use and adherence to local regulatory and pharmaceutical code requirements. The successful candidate will be based in Riyadh and report directly to the Regional Sales Manager. Role Purpose and Context The Medical Representative is responsible for defining and executing sales account plans based on local activity and expert engagement plans. The primary objective is to maximize the number of patients receiving Boehringer Ingelheim’s products by creating added value for key stakeholders. This position operates within the ROPU IMETA regional operating unit, which includes Saudi Arabia and other mid-sized operating units. Key Responsibilities Execute an effective Sales Action Plan to build and sustain long-term customer partnerships with key accounts, creating mutual value. Achieve sales and market share objectives, including the annual target. Perform and report on competitive intelligence activities related to key accounts. Orchestrate customer-centric engagement through collaboration with cross-functional and external stakeholders via pre-launch and launch activities, Audio Visual and CME meetings, and similar initiatives. Develop and maintain relationships with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). Prepare periodical activity trackers and sales-related reports/objectives. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to effectively represent and promote core products. Understanding of local regulatory and pharma code requirements. Demonstrated ability to define and execute sales account plans. Application Process Boehringer Ingelheim welcomes your application. Upon receipt of your CV, suitable candidates will be invited for a screening interview. In compliance with applicable export control laws, Boehringer Ingelheim periodically screens business relations, including job applicants, against sanctioned party lists. This process may involve the processing of personal data in relevant databases, including those of third-party vendors located or accessible outside the EU.

2fcb73382f7a34c7.description: About the Role Cummins Arabia is seeking a Service Technician for a full-time Saudization role in Dammam, Eastern region. This position is ideal for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are proficient in power generation systems. The Service Technician will serve as a customer-facing technical specialist, performing advanced diagnostics, complex problem-solving, and maintenance tasks on power generation systems at customer sites. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain productive customer relationships, ensuring prompt attention to customer needs. Perform advanced diagnostics, complex repairs, rebuilds, and preventative maintenance on power generation units. Identify and prepare necessary parts, tools, and support equipment for system uptime and diagnosis of downtime failures. Identify technical issues and implement preventive actions. Complete required documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, and quality documents. Communicate effectively with assigned teams and all support teams. Maintain service vehicle and tools to ensure cleanliness and proper operation. Adhere to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental and Quality training policies, procedures, and legislation. Technical Expertise and Support Apply documented procedures and policies for diagnostics, complex repairs, and assembly/disassembly of power generation units. Escalate unresolved technical issues to product specialists, DFSE, or supervisors. Provide training or introductions on product promotion, usage, and maintenance to field customers. Coach less experienced technicians, transferring knowledge and experience, and providing work direction. Support the Service Manager in enhancing the team's overall service capability by consolidating and sharing complex technical issue cases. Operational and Team Contributions Identify opportunities for work process improvements. Identify additional sales and service opportunities with customers. Assist the supervisor/service manager in organizing and coordinating headcount and overtime needs to meet delivery schedules. Assist management in fostering a team focused on continuous improvement. Lead, deliver, and contribute to Toolbox Talks. Complete training in line with job skill level and business requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of experience in a relevant technical field. The role requires full proficiency in power generation systems and adherence to established procedures and guidelines to enhance service workshop knowledge and skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring on-site work at customer locations. The role involves continuous development of technical skills and collaboration within a service-oriented team.

2fd1f9cc312e9f1a.description: About the Role Patchi is seeking a Senior Marketing Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for brand building and managing day-to-day marketing and communication tasks across all channels effectively. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Recommend and align with the KSA Marketing Director on the KSA MarCom strategy and plans, ensuring consistency with the Global brand strategy. Manage and follow up on local communication approaches, including media planning/buying, new launches and openings, as well as PR and event management. Execute the social media calendar to drive brand awareness, recognition, and engagement across relevant platforms. Regularly create engaging stories to maintain active accounts, track and improve reach and engagement, and share monthly social media reports. Execute PR plans, including events, sponsorships, and openings, along with creating suitable meeting occasions to generate brand buzz. Generate and evaluate new ideas for promotions, articles, press releases, and publicity, ensuring coordination and consistency with internal marketing/advertising professionals. Lead on local customer understanding, market trends, competition, and insights by regularly engaging with the market and sharing information with relevant local and global team members. Finalize copywriting in both Arabic and English for all communication requirements, including press, e-commerce, and online content. Educate and enforce brand standards internally to maintain consistency of brand, editorial tone, and style. Develop creative briefs for the internal creative team and external agencies, providing clear direction for deliverables. Coordinate with agencies and other vendors to ensure outsourced work is consistent, high quality, cost-effective, and reflects Patchi’s brand identity. Engage with fans and followers to build community relationships and encourage engagement. Handle local customer inquiries and complaints with relevant team members to ensure high brand satisfaction. Manage approved budgets diligently, update budget tracking sheets, and report regularly on budget status. Drive sales by analyzing campaign performance in terms of engagement and sales impact, and share post-campaign reports and recommendations. Maintain deep knowledge of the company’s products and stay updated with any relevant changes. Comply with company policies and procedures. Required Skills and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a marketing or communications role. Working knowledge of design tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Canva for quick, minor design tasks. Proficiency in copywriting in both Arabic and English. Strong understanding of social media platforms and engagement strategies. Experience in PR, event management, and media planning/buying. Ability to analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to a well-established brand in the region.

2fe51d91f01b2278.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Sr. Specialist IT Security to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on implementing, administering, and maintaining the organization's enterprise security technologies. The primary objective is to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems and data. Role Context and Objectives The Sr. Specialist IT Security provides advanced technical expertise across security operations, including threat monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, access governance, and compliance. The role involves enforcing corporate security standards aligned with international frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST, as well as Saudi national regulations like NCA ECC and OTCC. Collaboration with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Application, Service Desk, Cybersecurity, and Audit teams is essential to enhance the organization's cyber resilience. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain IT security reference architectures in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53, COBIT 2019, and applicable Saudi regulations (NCA ECC and OTCC). Implement, administer, and maintain enterprise security technologies including endpoint protection (EDR), next-generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, anti-malware, email and web security gateways, DLP, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM solutions. Continuously monitor security alerts, logs, and events; perform triage, investigation, escalation, and remediation of threats and incidents. Lead and support security incident response and forensic investigations, including containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis. Conduct risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and configuration reviews across systems, endpoints, networks, and cloud workloads; track findings through to closure. Collaborate with IT Infrastructure, Network, Applications, Cloud, and Service Desk teams to embed security-by-design principles into projects, systems, and change management processes. Apply security baselines, configuration hardening, and patch-management policies across servers, endpoints, and cloud environments (*, CIS Benchmarks). Administer identity and access governance, including access provisioning, privileged access management (PAM), and periodic user access reviews. Ensure secure deployment and configuration of firewalls, network security layers, proxies, and security appliances. Develop, enforce, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with enterprise governance. Support internal and external audits (*, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NCA compliance) through evidence collection, access reviews, and remediation tracking with Audit and Compliance teams. Maintain and periodically test disaster recovery and business continuity plans for security systems. Advise IT leadership on risk-mitigation strategies, emerging threats, and control improvements. Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles, and drive continuous improvement of security operations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in IT security is required for this role. Demonstrated expertise in implementing and maintaining enterprise security technologies. Familiarity with international security frameworks (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST) and Saudi national regulations (NCA ECC and OTCC). Work Type This is a full-time position within ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail.

2ff15eed5b27b727.description: About Raytheon Raytheon, a business within RTX, is a global aerospace and defense company with over 100 years of experience. The company focuses on delivering solutions that support national defense and deter aggression. Raytheon contributes to solving complex global problems through its engineering expertise and investments in research and development. The Role of Electronics Technician The Electronics Technician is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, requiring 5-10 years of experience. This critical role supports the sustainment of Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems, specifically focusing on Patriot MEI Deep Maintenance (DM) activities. The technician will participate in the improvement and repair of RSADF systems functions and perform other related duties as directed under the approved TAA. Key Responsibilities Assist in the disassembly, re-assembly, repair, and inspection of electronic, electrical, and mechanical systems, chassis, and personal computer boards. Perform technical tasks supporting DM processes, associated engineering, quality controls, calibration, production/test environments, and field operations. Test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, and install a variety of electronic, electromechanical, mechanical, computer, and laboratory equipment. Manage customer and company property tracking and control. Perform troubleshooting, testing, and failure repair of electronic parts. Utilize test consoles and test equipment proficiently. Participate in on-the-job training (OJT) programs. Provide assistance and technical support as required. Perform soldering and cable connections for electronic parts and components. Qualifications and Experience An AA/AS degree or other 2-year post-high school training is typically required. A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience is essential. Basic job knowledge of electronic or electrical systems. Ability to follow basic work routines and standards through on-the-job training (OJT). Experience in troubleshooting, fault isolation, repair, testing, and checkout procedures. Proficiency in soldering, splicing, and wire wrapping. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. Proficiency in the English language, both spoken and written. Knowledge of safety policies, procedures, and standards.

2f30bf2077824499.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Painter to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on maintaining the aesthetic quality of the property through professional painting and finishing work. Key Responsibilities Apply paint, stain, and other finishes to property walls, ceilings, and furniture using appropriate tools such as brushes, spray guns, or rollers. Prepare new surfaces for finish coats by applying primers or sealers. Remove old finishes through stripping, sanding, wire brushing, burning, or using water and/or abrasive blasting techniques. Cover surfaces with protective materials during painting and post appropriate paint signs to ensure safety and prevent damage. Clean up and properly store paint, painting tools, and equipment in designated areas. Coordinate with vendors to modify colors of paint, stain, or varnish as required. Operational and Safety Compliance Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries promptly. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Guest Service and Teamwork Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, including assisting individuals with disabilities. Thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Support the team to achieve common goals and ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Capability to move up and down a ladder. Skill to grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Capacity to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods of time. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support overall operations.

2f942a7d440e33ae.description: نبذة عن الدور يعلن معهد اكاديمية الزرقاء العالي للتدريب عن توفر شواغر وظيفية لمدرسي اللغة الأجنبية (اللغة الإنجليزية) في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يتولى المدرسون مسؤولية تقديم البرامج والدورات التدريبية بمختلف مستوياتها، بهدف تنمية مهارات المتدربين في اللغة الإنجليزية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنفيذ الدورات التدريبية في اللغة الإنجليزية بما يتوافق مع المناهج والخطط المعتمدة. تنمية مهارات المتدربين في المحادثة والاستماع والقراءة والكتابة. استخدام أساليب تدريب حديثة وتفاعلية تتناسب مع مستويات المتدربين المختلفة. إعداد الاختبارات والتقييمات الدورية لقياس مستوى تقدم المتدربين. متابعة حضور المتدربين وأدائهم، وإعداد التقارير التدريبية اللازمة. الالتزام بالجداول التدريبية والأنظمة والتعليمات المعتمدة لدى المعهد. المشاركة في تطوير البرامج التدريبية وتحسين جودة المخرجات التعليمية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريس اللغة الإنجليزية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم أداء المتدربين. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريس الفعال. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في معهد اكاديمية الزرقاء العالي للتدريب بالخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. تهدف بيئة العمل إلى دعم تحقيق الأهداف التدريبية ومعايير الجودة المعتمدة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

2f29a17eaa1a02ff.description: About the Role Siemens Energy is seeking an EHS Lead for Grid Technologies to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the Environmental, Health, and Safety strategy and execution for Grid Technologies Service operations across Saudi Arabia. The EHS Lead will be responsible for ensuring safe and compliant working conditions, fostering a Zero Harm safety culture, and managing a team of EHS professionals. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the EHS strategy for GT Service Saudi Arabia, including setting objectives, targets, and performance indicators, and driving continuous improvement. Oversee EHS execution across project sites and field service activities nationwide, with a focus on high-risk work such as electrical tasks, HV switching, lifting, confined space entry, and work at height. Ensure safe and compliant working conditions in offices, workshops, and warehouses, managing emergency preparedness, fire protection, and occupational health programs. Build and sustain a proactive Zero Harm safety culture through coaching managers and field personnel, running safety campaigns and behavioral safety initiatives, and integrating EHS into daily operations. Design and deliver EHS training and competency programs to ensure employees and contractors maintain required certifications and capabilities. Lead risk assessments, incident investigations, and root cause analysis, manage a team of three EHS professionals, and report performance metrics while leading audits and regulatory inspections. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Environmental, Health, and Safety roles, particularly within grid technologies or critical energy infrastructure. About the Team The Grid Technology division at Siemens Energy focuses on enabling a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid, which is essential for the energy transition. The team offers a portfolio of solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company with approximately 100,000 employees across more than 90 countries. The company develops future energy systems to meet global energy demand reliably and sustainably. Its technologies drive the energy transition and contribute to one-sixth of the world's electricity generation. Siemens Energy is committed to sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy, building on a 150-year legacy of innovation with a focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Diversity and Inclusion Siemens Energy values diversity and inclusion, with a workforce comprising over 130 nationalities. The company celebrates individual character and does not discriminate based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability, aiming to energize all of society.

2f3ada5d3d1878d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منهل المعرفة الأهلية عن معلم ابتدائي علوم ورياضيات للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتدريس وتوجيه طلاب المرحلة الابتدائية في مادتي العلوم والرياضيات، بما يتماشى مع المناهج المعتمدة والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير الدروس الخاصة بالعلوم والرياضيات بما يتوافق مع المناهج المعتمدة والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تدريس طلاب المرحلة الابتدائية وتيسير المناقشات الصفية، وتقديم الواجبات المنزلية، وإدارة سلوك الطلبة داخل الصف. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم التقدم الأكاديمي للطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم بهدف تحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي، وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء كل تلميذ على حدة، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة، وحضور اجتماعات الموظفين، والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريس العلوم والرياضيات للمرحلة الابتدائية. القدرة على تخطيط الدروس وتحضيرها بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوجيه مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في ينبع، المدينة المنورة، ويكون جزءًا من فريق تعليمي يسعى لتحقيق التميز الأكاديمي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

2f4b02f16c4ce818.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة هيفاء بديع القلم وشركاها العالميه للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءًا من بناء علاقات العملاء وحتى إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور مهارات قوية في التواصل والمتابعة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع تحديث بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم بانتظام. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لتقييم الأداء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها بشكل فعال. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. متطلبات العمل العمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الالتزام بتحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. بيئة العمل سيعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي في شركة هيفاء بديع القلم وشركاها العالميه للتجارة، حيث تتاح الفرصة لتطوير المهارات في بيئة داعمة تركز على تحقيق الأهداف وتنمية الأعمال. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

2f4bd376b0944331.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Project Manager to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing large-scale multi-disciplinary projects within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC Region. The successful candidate will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet client requirements. Key Responsibilities Communicate scope, fees, deliverables, and program to the team through Project Kick-Offs and regular updates. Manage sub-consultant agreements and payments, coordinating technical management through the Design Management function. Ensure the Project Execution Plan addresses design management requirements, including integration and interface management between client requirements and sub-consultant design packages. Support the Project Director (PD) in producing the Project Management suite of documents and standard forms. Assist in risk identification and management, and support the PD in identifying and managing scope changes and extensions. Identify resourcing issues and requirements, coordinating these with Technical Team Leads. Provide timely external and internal monthly reporting by implementing a planned delivery schedule. Ensure adherence to Quality Systems processes in project delivery and undertake debriefs with clients. Assist in managing projects financially, technically, and contractually. Financial Management Monitor Design Team progress and costs, highlighting deviations from planned costs and coordinating with Project Technical Leads to mitigate potential over-runs or underspends. Apply commercial acumen to proactively manage risks using provided tools, regular team and client engagement, and update contingency requirements at least once per design stage. Prepare invoices for review and sign-off by the Project Director and maintain up-to-date financial registers. Drive the change process and be responsible for the compilation of variations. Client and Team Management Liaise and interact with clients regarding the technical delivery components of projects. Work with the Atkins team and clients to establish project objectives, develop project plans, manage project budgets, and oversee project scheduling. Manage the project team, ensuring tasks are completed on time and communication is maintained. Manage project risk, develop contingency plans, and ensure adherence to health and safety standards, in addition to Atkins' project management methodology requirements. 2f9ac8a004fd865a.company_name: شركة هيفاء بديع القلم وشركاها العالميه للتجارة
2f9ac8a004fd865a.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة المذاق المميز للتجارة عن حاجتها لـ مدير فرع بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك. يتولى مدير الفرع الإدارة والإشراف الكامل على جميع العمليات التشغيلية والبيعية للفرع، مع التركيز على تحقيق الأهداف المعتمدة للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة مبيعات سنوية تتضمن المستهدفات البيعية وآليات تحقيقها، ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء والنتائج بشكل مستمر. تنمية المبيعات واستقطاب عملاء جدد، وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء، وتعزيز العلاقات مع العملاء الحاليين. الإشراف على أداء موظفي الفرع، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير الكفاءات، وتحفيز الموظفين. مراقبة سير العمليات التشغيلية والإدارية والبيعية، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المعتمدة. الإشراف على المخزون وحركة المنتجات، والتأكد من توفر الأصناف، ومتابعة النواقص والمرتجعات، والحد من الهدر والتالف. معالجة التحديات التشغيلية، والعمل على تطوير أداء الفرع ورفع كفاءته التشغيلية والبيعية. متابعة مستوى خدمة العملاء ومعالجة الشكاوى والملاحظات، والعمل على تحسين تجربة العملاء. بناء علاقات عمل مع العملاء والشركاء والجهات الخارجية ذات العلاقة. التنسيق المستمر مع الإدارات والأقسام ذات العلاقة لضمان تكامل الأعمال. متابعة المصروفات والاحتياجات التشغيلية للفرع، والعمل ضمن الميزانيات والصلاحيات المعتمدة. إعداد ورفع التقارير الدورية للإدارة العامة، متضمنة نتائج المبيعات ومؤشرات الأداء والتحديات والتوصيات. اقتراح وتنفيذ فرص التحسين والتطوير المستمر لزيادة الإيرادات ورفع كفاءة التشغيل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في إدارة الفروع أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على الإدارة الكاملة للفرع والإشراف على جميع أعماله التشغيلية والبيعية. مهارات قوية في إعداد خطط المبيعات وتحليل الأداء. القدرة على تنمية المبيعات واستقطاب العملاء. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة لإدارة وتقييم أداء الموظفين. القدرة على معالجة التحديات التشغيلية وتطوير أداء الفرع. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2ff1312fef962782.description: ميكانيكي سيارات لدى شركة أوتو سواب تبحث شركة أوتو سواب، المتخصصة في حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي لقطاع السيارات، عن ميكانيكي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم الدعم الفني لعملاء التطبيق ومراجعة المحتوى التقني للمساعد الذكي الذي تطوره الشركة. نبذة عن الدور يعمل ميكانيكي السيارات ضمن فريق شركة أوتو سواب لتقديم استشارات فنية دقيقة لأصحاب السيارات. يشمل الدور تشخيص الأعطال ومراجعة المحتوى التقني للمساعد الذكي، بالإضافة إلى إجراء فحوصات ميدانية عند الضرورة. تهدف هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان جودة المعلومات الفنية المقدمة للعملاء عبر منصة لقيا. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الاستشارات الفنية لعملاء التطبيق عبر قنوات مختلفة تشمل الكتابة والصوت والفيديو. تشخيص أعطال السيارات بناءً على وصف العميل، والصور، ومؤشرات لمبات التحذير. مراجعة إجابات المساعد الذكي، وتصحيحها، وتزويده بالمعلومات الفنية اللازمة. إجراء فحوصات ميدانية للسيارات لدى العملاء حسب الحاجة. توثيق الحالات والأعطال الشائعة، ورفع تقارير دورية حولها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ميكانيكا السيارات. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية للسيارات بدقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الاستشارات الفنية بوضوح. القدرة على مراجعة المحتوى الفني وتصحيحه. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في تطوير حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي لقطاع السيارات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2fe57763ece2588a.description: فرصة وظيفية | مدير عمليات مطاعم تعلن شركة كالوفت (CaloFit) عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمدينة الرياض. المسمى الوظيفي: مدير عمليات (Operations Manager) المهام والمسؤوليات: إدارة العمليات التشغيلية للمطبخ المركزي والفروع. الإشراف على جودة الإنتاج والخدمة. متابعة التكاليف والمخزون ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية. تنظيم الجداول التشغيلية وإدارة الصيانة. تدريب مديري الفروع وتطوير إجراءات العمل. متابعة مؤشرات الأداء وحل المشكلات التشغيلية. المتطلبات: خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في تشغيل المطاعم. بكالوريوس في الإدارة أو الضيافة. خبرة في إدارة الفرق والتكاليف والجودة. مهارات قيادية وتحليلية قوية. الراتب والمزايا: يبدأ الراتب من 6,000 ريال شهريًا، مع إمكانية الزيادة وفقًا للخبرة والكفاءة، ويُحدد الراتب النهائي بعد المقابلة الشخصية. موقع العمل: الرياض. للمهتمين، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع ذكر المسمى الوظيفي (C@*****************)

2f699e85304d83fe.description: نبحث عن موظف استقبال ودود ومهني للانضمام إلى فريقنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن الترحيب بالضيوف، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وتقديم الدعم الإداري العام. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على التنظيم، وشخصية استباقية، فنحن نشجعك على التقديم. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * الترحيب بالزوار والعملاء وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم. * الرد على المكالمات الهاتفية وتحويلها إلى الأقسام المعنية. * إدارة وتنظيم المواعيد وجداول الاجتماعات. * المساعدة في المهام الإدارية المختلفة مثل فرز البريد وتنظيم الملفات. * الحفاظ على منطقة الاستقبال مرتبة ومنظمة.

2f1eb9acf5a5d45b.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Coating Technician to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves supporting thermal spray coating operations for gas turbine components, including pre-coat and post-coat weighing and the application of coatings. The technician will execute process steps safely and accurately, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, and productivity. Key Responsibilities Perform coat application according to approved work instructions, process standards, and engineering requirements. Mask components for coating as per approved work instructions and process specifications, if required. Interpret work instructions and quality forms to ensure accurate coating application. Record and maintain precise process and measurement data. Operate coating equipment, weighing devices, fixtures, and hand tools safely. Inspect parts before and after coating to ensure adherence to quality standards. Adhere to Standard Work and Standard Work Combination Sheets for consistency, quality, safety, and efficient line flow. Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area in line with 5S standards. Support improvements in standard work, line organization, visual management, and process discipline. Contribute to team efforts to enhance line performance, operational efficiency, and overall shop productivity. Work within takt time, cycle time, and standard process flow expectations to meet production goals. Utilize shop floor systems and interfaces such as ELM and SmartShop, as needed. Comply with company quality policies, safety requirements, applicable procedures, and standard work. 2f2595de414b36f4.description: نبحث عن متخصص مبيعات متخصص في حلول البرمجيات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات لقطاع الأعمال (B2B) للانضمام إلى فريقنا الديناميكي. سيكون المرشح المثالي مسؤولاً عن تحديد فرص المبيعات الجديدة، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام الرئيسية: * تحديد العملاء المحتملين في قطاع الأعمال وتطوير استراتيجيات مبيعات فعالة. * تقديم عروض تفصيلية للحلول البرمجية وتكنولوجيا المعلومات للعملاء. * إدارة دورة المبيعات بالكامل من التواصل الأولي إلى إغلاق الصفقة. * بناء والحفاظ على علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين والجدد. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية. * البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث اتجاهات التكنولوجيا والبرمجيات في السوق.

The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Greet and assist walk-in parts retail customers, identifying correct parts and accessories based on customer and vehicle requirements. Process parts retail and service sales orders accurately in SAP, ensuring correct pricing, discounts, and invoicing in line with CEER commercial policy. Promote accessories and value-added parts/service offers to maximize basket size and support retail sales targets. Coordinate with Service Advisors and Technicians to fulfill parts requirements for scheduled and walk-in service jobs. Pick, verify, and issue parts against repair orders and work orders in a timely manner to minimize vehicle turnaround time. Follow up on back-ordered or unavailable parts and communicate expected availability to service teams and customers. Respond to customer inquiries regarding part availability, pricing, and compatibility. Handle first-line customer complaints related to parts sales and escalate complex issues to the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Process returns, exchanges, and warranty claims according to established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Maintain accurate records of retail and service sales transactions and daily cash/counter stock reconciliation. Generate routine daily/weekly sales activity reports for the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Support month-end stock and sales reconciliation activities. Adhere to CEER Aftersales SOPs & Policies requirements for all transactions and maintain a clean, organized, and safe parts retail/counter area. Familiarity with SAP for order processing is preferred. Ability to identify correct parts and accessories based on customer and vehicle requirements. Strong organizational skills for maintaining accurate records and managing stock. The Parts Advisor will work at the parts counter and within the service center to ensure efficient parts fulfillment.

2f48af26a8b96a6e.description: About Tata Consultancy Services Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization with over 50 years of experience partnering with global businesses in their transformation journeys. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive-powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology, and engineering services and solutions. The company operates with a Location Independent Agile™ delivery model and is part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, employing over 616,171 consultants across 53 countries. Role Overview: End User Computing (EUC) Engineer TCS is seeking an End User Computing (EUC) Engineer for Retail & Warehouse Support in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive technical support for EUC equipment and software across office, retail store, and warehouse environments. The engineer will be responsible for incident resolution, equipment installation, and coordination of support activities to ensure operational efficiency and adherence to service levels. Key Responsibilities Resolve incidents and problems related to EUC equipment and software, providing break/fix support, advice, and assistance to users in office, stores, and warehouses. Provide onsite support or dispatch support specialists as needed to ensure operational and technical support, meeting agreed service levels. Communicate service request and incident status updates to end users. Install and configure new equipment and software, including upgrades, in accordance with established standards and change management procedures. Coordinate, plan, and schedule IMACs (Install, Move, Add, Change) with relevant IT functions. Validate IMAC requests from users or the Service Desk for correctness and proper authorization. Manage and support Desktops, Laptops, VDIs, and accessories. Coordinate with vendors for printer and peripheral replacements/provisioning and allocation. Retire IT equipment belonging to stores. Configure printer drivers. Configure BO Servers, POS systems, Routers, Switches, Wi-Fi Access Points, PDTs/Pathfinders, LJ Printers/MFPs, and Thermal Printers. Configure Footfall systems, Bio-Metric Attendance, Single-Swipe on POS, Telephone PABX, and Phone Extensions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring onsite support across various retail and warehouse locations. The role involves coordination with internal IT functions, end users, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless IT operations.

2f213f98af3a6079.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة إيلاف السعودية عن حاجتها لمدير عمليات تشغيل (Chief Operating Officer - COO) للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير العمليات الإشراف اليومي على تقديم جميع خدمات إدارة المرافق ضمن عقود الشركة، بما في ذلك الصيانة والنظافة والضيافة واستلام وتسليم الوحدات. يهدف الدور إلى قيادة فرق المواقع، ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية، وضبط التكاليف، وضمان الالتزام الأداء والميزانيات ومعايير الجودة. تنسيق الأولويات اليومية والموارد وطلبات الخدمة والصيانة والمشتريات والتخطيط التشغيلي. متابعة الأداء، وحل المشكلات المصعّدة، ومعالجة المخاطر التشغيلية. قيادة مدراء المواقع والمشرفين والفرق الميدانية وتوجيههم وتقييم أدائهم. تخطيط القوى العاملة وجداول المناوبات بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العقود وحجم العمل. قيادة تحشيد العقود الجديدة وإنهاء العقود المنتهية. وضع مستهدفات تشغيلية لكل موقع ومتابعتها مقابل مؤشرات الأداء واتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة. استخدام بيانات نظام CAFM وأوامر العمل لتحديد الأعطال المتكررة ومعالجة أسبابها الجذرية. إعداد تقارير العمليات الأسبوعية والشهرية لمدير إدارة العمليات والعملاء. إعداد ومتابعة الميزانية التشغيلية والتدفق النقدي الشهري لكل عقد، ومراقبة التكاليف. العمل كنقطة التواصل التشغيلية الرئيسية مع العملاء وحل الشكاوى. ضمان التزام جميع العمليات بسياسات الشركة للصحة والسلامة والبيئة وأنظمة العملاء ولوائح المملكة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قيادة الفرق الميدانية وتحفيزها. فهم عميق لعمليات إدارة المرافق والمشتريات والصحة والسلامة والجودة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات التشغيلية واستخدام أنظمة مثل CAFM. معرفة بمعايير ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001. مهارات قوية في إدارة الميزانية والتحكم في التكاليف. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الإشراف المباشر على العمليات اليومية في مواقع وعقود متعددة، مع التركيز على تحقيق الكفاءة التشغيلية ورضا العملاء. الامتثال والمعايير يجب على مدير عمليات التشغيل التأكد من تطبيق تقييمات المخاطر وتصاريح العمل واجتماعات السلامة الميدانية، والتحقيق في الحوادث. كما يتوجب عليه متابعة تدقيقات الجودة والسجلات وفق معايير ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 حسب الحاجة، وإدارة مقاولي الباطن والأدوات والمعدات وقطع الغيار، مع ضمان توفير بيئة سكن وعمل مناسبة للعمالة وفق معايير الشركة والعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في شركة إيلاف السعودية.

2f10e4bae8d03bd3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Project Engineer TL to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position responsible for the comprehensive management of transmission projects, from initial design through to final handover. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in project engineering. Key Responsibilities Manage transmission projects from the base design stage through to final handover and acceptance, ensuring adherence to the scope of work, company standards, and specifications. Coordinate all activities related to electrical components within projects. Monitor project schedules and budgets, ensuring timely completion and financial control. Review and approve material submittals, shop drawings, and as-built drawings. Forward engineering transmittals to relevant SEC divisions as required. Prepare regular technical reports and monthly progress updates for the Project Manager. Develop detailed weekly programs for construction activities and prepare manpower/resource requirements to achieve project completion on schedule. Liaise with the construction/project manager, client, and subcontractors, and supervise allocated construction activities. Ensure compliance with project specifications to meet client satisfaction. Monitor daily operations, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, tracking project budgets, and keeping deliverables on schedule using P6 Primavera. Required Experience Candidates for this Project Engineer TL position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in managing transmission projects. Location and Work Type This is a full-time role based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The position involves working on site to oversee project execution and coordination.

2fa753cb3c57804d.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking a Studies Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the distribution and review of technical and legal studies, approving their outcomes, and determining appropriate actions for applications. The supervisor will ensure data quality and compliance with established standards and procedures, while also monitoring the performance of the studies team and coordinating with relevant committees. Key Responsibilities Monitor task allocation and reassign assignments in cases of delays or increased workload, ensuring technical reviewers are assigned surveying and data-related tasks according to their areas of specialization. Determine the appropriate level of review based on risk levels and monitor compliance with established turnaround times. Review and approve technical and legal studies, and determine the appropriate committee for each application. Resolve discrepancies between technical and legal study outcomes and address delayed requests for additional information. Approve updates to data layers, restricted areas, and their effective dates. Approve amendments to requirements, deadlines, and reference lists, ensuring that the reasons for such changes are properly documented. Monitor data quality, coding accuracy, and adherence to scheduled update cycles in accordance with the Authority’s data governance policies. Coordinate with relevant committees, monitor team performance indicators, and support the team in addressing operational challenges. Manage and supervise a studies or review team. Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and prepare periodic performance reports. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team environment focused on ensuring high standards in technical and legal studies. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

2fdcc0613a9fbd6b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي والمشورة في مجال الزراعة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب اللازمة لدعم الإنتاج الزراعي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الاختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية، وتحديد تأثيرات طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على النمو والعائد. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية وتحديد الطفيليات أو الكائنات الضارة الأخرى. تفتيش المزارع وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، بما في ذلك الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمشورة بخصوص تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تطبيقها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية المستخدمة لتحليل العينات وتحديد الكائنات الحية واختبار الجودة. دعم الأخصائيين الزراعيين والمزارعين في مهامهم. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الزراعة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمبادئ الزراعية وتقنيات الإنتاج. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات المعملية والميدانية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في الملاحظة. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية بوضوح. مهارات تشغيل وصيانة المعدات المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة كرم الوطن. يتطلب العمل التواجد الميداني في المزارع والمختبرات لإجراء المهام المطلوبة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f187591117cf4fe.description: About Novotel Hotels Novotel Hotels is part of the Accor network, a global group encompassing over 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and various lifestyle destinations. Accor is committed to fostering development and advancement opportunities for its team members. The organization emphasizes responsible hospitality, where every interaction contributes to a positive impact for customers, colleagues, and the planet. Role Overview: Director of Sales & Marketing Novotel Hotels in Makkah is seeking a Director of Sales & Marketing. This full-time role involves leading the sales and marketing efforts to achieve revenue growth and market positioning objectives for the hotel. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to maximize occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and RevPAR. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximize hotel revenue, occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR. Lead, manage, and motivate the Sales & Marketing team, ensuring the achievement of departmental objectives and key performance indicators. Identify and develop new business opportunities across key market segments, including Hajj and Umrah operators, corporate accounts, travel agencies, tour operators, and international markets. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, strategic partners, travel agencies, and corporate accounts to generate consistent business opportunities. Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and promotional activities to strengthen the hotel's brand presence and market positioning. Develop and manage the annual sales and marketing budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and achievement of financial targets. Work closely with the Revenue Management team to develop pricing strategies, sales forecasts, market positioning, and distribution plans. Monitor market trends, competitor performance, customer preferences, and industry developments to identify opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. Oversee key sales activities, including corporate negotiations, group bookings, international business development, client visits, and participation in industry events and trade shows. Manage the hotel's online presence and distribution channels, including the hotel's website, online travel agencies (OTAs), and other digital platforms, in coordination with relevant departments. Analyze sales performance, market share, campaign results, and revenue reports to evaluate effectiveness and implement corrective actions when required. Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with hotel brand standards, company policies, and established operational procedures. Collaborate with the General Manager and other department heads to align commercial strategies with the hotel's overall business objectives and operational requirements. Prepare and present regular sales performance reports, market updates, business forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management. Drive continuous improvement, team development, and a customer-focused approach to support the hotel's long-term commercial success. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in sales and marketing, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective sales and marketing strategies. Proven leadership skills with experience managing and motivating a team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with various hotel departments and engagement with external partners and clients.

2f14f1ef223d49fa.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services, aiming to enhance project potential and redefine ambition. The company is currently providing strategic project management consultancy for significant new stadium builds, multiple stadium redevelopments, and wider precinct transformations in Riyadh. This scope includes delivering new stadiums, increasing existing stadium capacities, developing major mixed-use amenities, and implementing robust knowledge-transfer programs to ensure operational excellence and long-term sustainability beyond construction. The Role: FIFA Design Compliance Expert The FIFA Design Compliance Expert will join a dedicated team responsible for managing all FIFA and World Cup requirements throughout the design process for Stadium and Training site Programmes in Riyadh. This part-time role involves providing authoritative interpretation, design assurance, and strategic guidance from concept design through detailed design, technical approvals, and design freeze. The expert will collaborate closely with the client, World Cup Authority, FIFA, Lead Designers, specialist consultants, and programme teams to ensure that permanent works and planned overlay are coordinated, compliant, buildable, and aligned with operational, legacy, cost, and programmed objectives. Key Responsibilities Interface with FIFA, the World Cup Authority, and the client, contributing to design reviews, technical workshops, submissions, and approval meetings, and providing clear positions on compliance, design acceptability, derogations, and risks. Manage and maintain FIFA design requirements, compliance matrices, and design assurance plans, translating FIFA stadium standards and host requirements into clear briefs, criteria, and actions for all design disciplines. Review and challenge stadium designs from concept through detailed design to confirm compliance across various areas including field of play, seating bowl and sightlines, spectator circulation, accessibility, safety and security, broadcast, media, hospitality, team and official facilities, back-of-house areas, masterplan tournament mode design, logistics, transport interfaces, and fan experience. Establish design-stage compliance gateways and coordinate the preparation, quality assurance, and submission of design reports, drawings, schedules, dashboards, and evidence packs required for FIFA and authority reviews. Coordinate multidisciplinary design integration across architecture, structural engineering, MEP, ICT, security, fire and life safety, vertical transportation, landscape, wayfinding, acoustics, lighting, broadcast, and specialist venue systems, ensuring interfaces and spatial requirements are resolved before design freeze from a FIFA perspective. Coordinate permanent works with temporary and overlay requirements, identifying where provisions, capacities, routes, loadings, spaces, and connection points must be embedded in the base design to avoid late redesign or unnecessary long-term cost. Provide programme-wide design assurance across multiple stadiums and training facilities, reporting compliance status, design risks, departures, decisions, and mitigation actions, while promoting consistency and lessons learned across the venue portfolio. Advise client leadership and design teams on FIFA strategy, value engineering, design changes, approvals, and legacy outcomes, ensuring cost or programme decisions do not compromise mandatory compliance or venue functionality. Qualifications and Experience A degree in architecture, engineering, sports venue design, or a related discipline. Professional accreditation and FIFA-related credentials are desirable. Extensive design-stage experience on FIFA World Cup stadiums and training facilities, major football venues, or comparable international event venues, with involvement from concept design through detailed design and approvals. Proven experience interpreting FIFA stadium requirements and converting them into design briefs, compliance matrices, review comments, technical submissions, and coordinated design solutions. Strong technical understanding of stadium planning and design, including seating bowl geometry and sightlines, crowd movement, accessibility, safety and security, fire and life safety, broadcast and media, hospitality, player and official facilities, back-of-house operations, and overlay interfaces. Experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and resolving interfaces between architecture, engineering, specialist venue systems, operational requirements, BIM coordination, and temporary event infrastructure. Programme-level experience providing design assurance across multiple stadiums, training sites, or sport venues, with the ability to manage compliance, risk, cost, programme, approvals, and legacy considerations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, provide clear design direction, and constructively challenge consultants and senior stakeholders.

2f2b10e2b4f5c5b6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية الأساسية والشخصية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية آخر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في تخطيط وإدارة رعاية المرضى. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة وإحالة المرضى إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم الوجبات والمشروبات حسب خطط الرعاية. مساعدة المرضى في التنقل والالتفاف وتغيير الوضع، بالإضافة إلى مساعدتهم في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. تطوير المعرفة والخبرة الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر. دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية ذات الصلة. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه.

2fb550902edb1a0b.description: About ARO Drilling ARO Drilling is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist II to join its team. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar. 2fd8bd1e2ef705f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدرب رياضي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اكتشاف ميول اللاعبين ومواهبهم واستعداداتهم، وإعداد خطط لتنميتها وتعزيزها وتنفيذها. إعداد الخطط التدريبية قصيرة وطويلة الأمد، وتطويرها لتحديد عناصر اللياقة البدنية وتنميتها. تطوير المهارات الأساسية للعبة الرياضية التي يتم تدريب اللاعبين عليها، وتقييم أدائهم وتنمية مهاراتهم. إدارة المقابلات الرياضية، وتوجيه اللاعبين وتبديلهم وفقاً لمجريات المقابلة. تطبيق قانون وقواعد اللعبة ومتابعة تطورها بشكل مستمر. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على اكتشاف وتطوير المواهب الرياضية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم الأداء. معرفة عميقة بقوانين وقواعد اللعبة الرياضية وتطوراتها. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب الرياضي ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالحديثة، مما يتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة ومحددة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدن قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. تقديم التقارير يتولى المدرب مسؤولية إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل دورية توثق تقدم اللاعبين والخطط التدريبية المنفذة، مع ضمان حفظ هذه التقارير بشكل دقيق ومنظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f61c0d35ee46496.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Legal Senior Researcher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves operating with minimal supervision, working within established guidelines and procedures to prepare complex and specialized legal reports. The successful candidate will contribute to achieving milestones and operational targets within the assigned functional area. Role Purpose This position focuses on undertaking operational legal activities, including conducting comprehensive legal research and preparing legal studies for committees. These studies will primarily relate to fines and customs assessments imposed by ZATCA. A key responsibility will be ensuring the completeness and accuracy of data within legal files. Key Responsibilities Draft ZATCA legal lawsuit management policies, guidelines, and standard model forms. Assist in identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of legal systems, processes, and practices through research of global best practices and trends. Develop relevant templates for lawsuit management services across all ZATCA functions. Support the development of negotiating strategies in conjunction with internal stakeholders for effective legal case management. Manage the continuous update of lawsuit management database systems, ensuring request logs are current. Conduct preliminary evaluations to assist in determining the severity and urgency of litigation cases against ZATCA. Assist in representing ZATCA before judicial bodies, committees, and governmental authorities in cases for or against the authority, ensuring all necessary supporting documents are available. Prepare settlements for negotiation with employees and external entities involved in lawsuits against ZATCA (excluding audit and collection-related settlements). Archive judgments from lawsuits won by ZATCA for future reference. Identify outsourced legal experts to provide additional legal advice for managing internal and external non-tax, zakat, and customs litigation cases. Adhere to all relevant policies, processes, and standard operating procedures to ensure consistent work execution. Support junior team members in resolving escalated problems and provide necessary assistance for efficient work completion. Escalate complex problems to the appropriate personnel to ensure proper resolution of cases and issues. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a structured environment, requiring adherence to established guidelines and procedures while allowing for independent work under minimal supervision.

2f95ce8623ad7a9e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة للعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة مهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة المتخصصة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع المناسب للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد المناسبة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة. معرفة بأسس ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. مهارات في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق في شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: جدة. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

2f58623f14272b06.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات عن أخصائي زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير الأساليب الزراعية لزيادة الكفاءة الإنتاجية، وإعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات الزراعية، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية لزراعة المحاصيل والخضراوات وبساتين أشجار الفاكهة، وتقييم جدوى زراعتها. إعداد برامج تحضير الأرض للزراعة، واختيار النمط الزراعي المناسب، وتنظيم الدورة الزراعية. تطوير الأساليب الزراعية بهدف رفع الكفاءة الإنتاجية للمحاصيل. إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات الزراعية والحصاد، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. متابعة إجراءات تجهيز المنتجات الزراعية لعمليات ما بعد الحصاد، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال الزراعية، وعرضها وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال الزراعي. القدرة على دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية للمحاصيل وتقييم جدوى الزراعة. معرفة بأساليب إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

2f7e52563cd77c4b.description: Job description Overview & Responsibilities The Senior Application Engineer serves as a technical authority and strategic commercial partner within the rotating equipment and turbomachinery manufacturing sector. This role is responsible for leading the design, proposal development, and commercial execution of mission-critical centrifugal machinery including compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps—for major global clients across Petrochemical, LNG, and emerging Clean Energy markets. Position Purpose Serve as a technical subject matter expert in the application and system integration of centrifugal rotating equipment, including centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps. Architect and deliver competitive, high-reliability technical proposals and engineered-to-order solutions tailored to client specifications across the Petrochemical, LNG, and Sustainability markets. Deliver joint technical and commercial leadership to expand market share, support sales pursuits, and advance key strategic business initiatives. Serve as the primary technical bridge across multidisciplinary teams—liaising with engineering, operations, global manufacturing hubs, and customer representatives to clarify bid details and create high-impact promotional technical materials. Key Responsibilities Proposal Engineering & Equipment Design Inquiry Evaluation & Bid Strategy: Thoroughly analyze customer inquiries, design requests, and tender specifications to evaluate project objectives, aligning closely with sales teams to devise competitive bidding strategies based on market trends, budgets, and competitive dynamics. Aerodynamic & Mechanical Machine Sizing: Perform comprehensive machine sizing and engineering analyses, covering aerodynamic performance, rotordynamic stability, stress and strain evaluations, and overall mechanical integrity. Scope Definition & Balance of Plant: Define the scope of supply for equipment packages and auxiliary systems surrounding the primary turbomachinery train. Cost Engineering & Estimation: Build accurate cost models encompassing core hardware, labor, engineering hours, drafting, vendor-supplied components, testing, and project-specific contingency costs. Vendor Sourcing & Sub-Supplier Specifications: Author technical specifications for major purchased auxiliary equipment and act as the principal engineering authority managing sub-vendor technical evaluations. Proposal Delivery: Assemble and issue comprehensive proposal packages, including detailed engineering data sheets, performance curves, scope matrices, pricing breakdowns, project delivery schedules, and technical/commercial exceptions and deviations. Sales Support: Assist sales representatives in delivering technical presentations, value propositions, and bid walk-throughs to customer evaluation teams. Technical & Commercial Support (Quote-to-Award Phase) Bid Clarifications: Rapidly resolve technical and commercial queries raised by sales teams and client engineering teams throughout the bidding cycle. Proposal Optimization: Revise and re-rate equipment configurations, scopes, and proposals as project parameters and customer requirements evolve. Commercial Alignment: Partner with sales and executive management to fine-tune scope, delivery schedules, and pricing structures to maintain competitive positioning while preserving gross margins. Pre-Contract Alignment: Participate directly in pre-award meetings, customer clarification sessions, and contract negotiation discussions. Project Transfer & Post-Order Support Global Team Handover: Transition awarded contracts smoothly to project execution teams in the USA and Japan. Design Specification Handover: Prepare final design specifications and baseline engineering documents reflecting final negotiated terms. Kick-Off Coordination: Lead and attend internal and client-facing kick-off meetings and formal handover sessions. Project Definition Packages: Compile and deliver comprehensive project handover packages—including original and revised inquiry specifications, final scope definitions, detailed costing files, delivery milestones, and engineering schedules—to assigned Project Managers. Ongoing Engineering Advisory: Serve as the continuous technical and commercial consultant to the Project Manager throughout the detailed engineering, procurement, and testing phases. Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement Design Automation: Develop and refine standardized workflows, automating repetitive calculation routines and equipment selection procedures to accelerate inquiry turnaround times. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enhance interface protocols and information sharing between internal divisions, specifically between the New Equipment engineering team and the Rerate/Aftermarket services group. Technology & Market Intelligence: Stay at the forefront of turbomachinery technology through industry periodicals, trade symposiums, technical papers, and formal internal/external training programs. Competitive Analysis: Monitor competitor offerings, patent releases, and customer trends to identify emerging technology applications and continuous product enhancement opportunities. Strategic Market Initiatives & Business Development Market Analytics: Leverage specialized engineering expertise, commercial insight, and industry networks to conduct quantitative and qualitative market assessments. Technical Thought Leadership: Author white papers, application guidelines, and technical reports to assist sales and marketing in launching new technologies and penetrating emerging applications. Client Engagement: Lead high-level technical presentations to engineering contractors (EPCs) and end users to drive brand preference and early-stage project specification development. Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (or equivalent) with extensive understanding of aerodynamic and thermodynamic performance principles (gas properties, heat transfer, efficiency, head, work). Proven design and application knowledge of centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, pumps, and key auxiliary packages (motors, gears, lube systems, etc.). Strong mechanical and analytical capabilities in rotordynamics, bearings, seals, metallurgy/materials, and dynamic/thermal stress and strain. Proven techno-commercial capability to strategically balance equipment cost, performance, delivery lead times, and operating reliability. Familiarity with target sectors and emerging sustainability markets, including Hydrogen, CCS/CCUS, Ammonia, and Energy Storage. Strong written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail for authoring customer proposals, technical papers, procedures, and presenting in commercial meetings. Proficiency with engineering application software, standard productivity tools (Word, Excel, Lotus Notes), and Sun/IBM operating environments. Ability to travel an average of 4–6 times per year (typically 2–3 days per trip) to support sales pursuits, attend pre-contract meetings, participate in trade shows/discussion groups, present technical papers, and complete off-site training. Base Location & Work Schedule ​This is a permanent full time, remote position based in Saudi Arabia or Bahrain. The world turns to Elliott. Customers throughout the world choose Elliott for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. Elliott’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Customers everywhere turn to Elliott for precision engineering, extraordinary reliability and unparalleled service. #LI-BD1 To learn more about our Job Applicant Privacy Notice, please click here . Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

2f0ab2a580dec581.description: About the Opportunity Parsons Corporation is seeking a Planner to join the Construction Supervision team for a significant landmark development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to a large-scale destination development that includes iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Project Context The project operates under a client governance framework with strict requirements for program, quality, safety, and sustainability. As the Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC), Parsons is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management. This ensures all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support both successful operations and long-term legacy objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update detailed project schedules for construction supervision activities using Primavera P6. Establish project baselines and monitor progress against approved schedules, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions. Review contractors' baseline schedules, recovery plans, and progress updates to ensure compliance with project requirements. Perform critical path analysis, schedule health checks, and what-if scenario assessments to support decision-making. Analyze project progress, milestones, delays, and potential risks, providing recommendations for mitigation and recovery strategies. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and client representatives to ensure alignment of project schedules and activities. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, dashboards, look-ahead schedules, and executive summaries for project leadership and the client. Monitor key project performance indicators (KPIs) and support forecasting of project completion dates. Evaluate extension of time (EOT) submissions, delay analyses, and time impact assessments. Support change management processes by assessing schedule impacts arising from variations and scope changes. Facilitate progress review meetings and provide planning expertise throughout all phases of project execution. Mentor junior planners and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, tools, templates, and reporting processes. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this Planner role should possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in project planning and scheduling, preferably within large-scale construction or development projects. Proficiency in Primavera P6 is required. Work Location This position is based on-site in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Parsons is committed to delivering successful project outcomes. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.
